name: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians
definition: A ray-marching algorithm implemented on 3D Gaussians to study the impact of approximations like spatial overlap and sorting in 3DGS.
summary: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians is a volumetric rendering method that accurately computes integrals by evaluating Gaussian mixtures along rays, distinguishing itself from standard splatting by replacing rasterization with adaptive, extinction-based integration to handle primitive overlap and self-attenuation.
